CustomField.description: Net Revenue Retention = (Existing MRR + Expansion MRR - Churn/Contraction MRR) / Existing MRR x 100. Computed as Current_MRR__c / Existing_MRR__c x 100, since Current_MRR__c already nets expansion and churn together. Blank when there is no Existing MRR baseline (e.g. New Business).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Net Revenue Retention: this Quote's resulting MRR as a percentage of the prior contract's MRR. Includes expansion. 100% = no change, above 100% = grew, below 100% = shrank.
CustomField.label: NRR
